summary.text: Steven St John is a no-party candidate for Nevada's 1st Congressional District. In his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, he describes himself as a hospital chaplain in Las Vegas for nearly a decade and says he is running on healthcare, housing and cost-of-living issues and on working across party lines.

paragraphs.text: Earned a high school diploma from New Trier High School and a master's degree from San Diego State University (1976, per Ballotpedia's education listing).

Ballotpedia reports he previously worked in advertising, marketing and business development, and as a chaplain; in his 2026 survey he describes about a decade as a hospital chaplain in Las Vegas and says he served as a chaplain under Mayor Goodman's faith initiative, ministering to people experiencing homelessness.
In his survey he says he was self-employed as a young man doing fence refinishing and home improvement work, and that he experienced homelessness for several months in the early 1980s.
Ballotpedia states that he and his wife live in Henderson, Nevada. In his survey he says he is not a career politician.

sources.title: Steven St John - Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey (June 18, 2026)
